scientific_integrity: All principal claims are analytically derived; finite checks are corroborative. The sphere limit is known background. Independent audit has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Congruent coaxial spheroids separated axially, with d>2a.
Inverse requires a and d to be known.
No finite-sample stability or definitive historical priority is asserted.
Earlier sphere-special-case literature not inspected in full.
title: One-bit Crofton recovery of coaxial spheroids from random planar sections
